changelog.title: Your inventory, in the launcher
changelog.summary: Browse your Steam skins and B2G items, check exact item details and refresh Steam inventory from the launcher. Supported knives and missing legacy finishes now import correctly.

news.title: Welcome back to Counter-Strike.
news.summary: A refined launcher with smooth hover effects, guided installation and account setup. Your matches, inventory and settings stay close at hand.

changes.text: An Inventory tab with search, Steam/B2G filters, item details and Steam refresh.
Supported knives, including Karambit Gamma Doppler, and legacy skins omitted by inventory import now appear.
Steam refresh shows its cooldown and privacy status while keeping saved items visible.
Stopped signed-out setup and Settings from flashing between loading screens.
Signing out clears account data while keeping installation status visible and discarding late responses.
Steam sign-in keeps setup in place while loading your profile, with retry after connection problems.
A Tauri interface for Play, Trading, Match history, Friends and Settings.
Clear two-sided trade selection and review, with retained drafts and quiet updates.
Readable controls, responsive layouts and reliable Starting / In game status.
First-time setup, reduced motion, and one launcher window per session.
Private or unavailable Steam inventory no longer blocks Play.
Clear FACEIT exit guidance and launch-error details.
Uninstall no longer restores an older B2G version from a backup.
Installation settings with repair and B2G uninstall controls.
Remove B2G while keeping Steam's CS:GO, settings, demos and loadout.
Missing in-game skins caused by conflicting restored equipment.
Preserve saved loadouts during local installation resets.
CS:GO startup errors after a fresh installation.
Friends, player search and native friend requests.
Player profiles with ELO, Steam links and mode-specific match stats.
Refined icons, template details and five local profile pictures.
Clear first-install guidance when CS2 is installed.
CS2 download bytes no longer appear as CS:GO progress.
Guided CS:GO installation and native profile setup.
Template artwork, layout and smooth hover effects.
Real loading progress and reduced-motion support.
Clear sign-in recovery and accessible setup controls.
Settings, match history and demo downloads.
Hidden console with optional debug viewer.
Fluid Trading updates and refined icons.
1,000 XP per level; existing XP preserved.
B2G player trading, offers and gifts.
Item previews and durable trade history.
Ownership-safe inventory and StatTrak sync.
Clean up case popup work after Escape.
Ignore late callbacks for closed case popups.
Refined native launcher layout and type.
Scrollable news and release notes.
Clearer states and window controls.
93% cases, 5% souvenirs, 2% pins.
Medal action only at level 40.
Correct item rarity colors in chat.
Redeem service medals in game.
2015–2023 medals and tier upgrades.
Owned skins in practice matches.
StatTrak synchronization and server scheduling.
